title: Stir-Fried Aubergine with Baby Bok Choy and Congee
description: A simple and delicious stir-fry recipe combining the flavors of aubergine, baby bok choy, and congee. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the sliced aubergine and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, or until it starts to soften.
Add the chopped baby bok choy and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Add the cooked congee and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Season with soy sauce and salt to taste.
